full_prompt_en: A square surreal graphic illustration is dominated by an enormous horizontal eye at its center. The almond shape stretches almost from side to side, its white surface modeled with dense black stippling and short engraved curves. A dark circular pupil sits inside a ringed black-and-gold iris, with many fine golden rays radiating toward its edge. The eyelids have thick, scale-like hatched borders, making the eye feel both organic and constructed. Around it, a compressed architectural collage packs the frame with small stepped platforms, black-and-white block forms, red horizontal bands, columns, arches, and geometric emblems. A pale gold central pillar descends from beneath the eye and divides the lower area; its surface carries symmetrical angular markings. On the lower left, a gray stone-like hand or animal form curls over steps. On the lower right, another low sculptural shape sits beside narrow red lattice lines. Above the eye, tiny eye motifs, a small white flower, curving gold shapes, and a red pointed form appear among dark cubical masses. The palette is tightly limited to black, silver-white, warm antique gold, and vivid crimson. Nearly every light surface is covered in dots, hatch marks, or tiny repeated patterns, giving the image a print-like, engraved surface rather than smooth digital shading. Bright highlights strike raised edges and gold accents while the black ground remains deep and opaque. The composition feels symmetrical at first glance, yet small asymmetric symbols keep it restless. The whole image reads as an enigmatic emblematic world, meticulously built from a central gaze and a dense border of patterned fragments.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实图形插画由中央一只巨大的横向眼睛主导。杏仁状轮廓几乎从左伸到右，眼白以密集黑点和短版刻弯线塑造。深色圆瞳位于黑金环形虹膜中，许多细金线向外放射。眼睑带厚重、鳞片般的排线边框，让眼睛同时显得有机又像构件。周围压缩的建筑拼贴把小阶台、黑白方块、红色横带、柱、拱和几何徽记塞满画幅。一根淡金中央立柱从眼下垂落并分开下部，表面有对称角形标记。左下，一个灰色石质手形或兽形弯伏在台阶上；右下另一个低矮雕塑形体坐在细红格线旁。眼上方，小眼睛图案、白色小花、弯曲金形和红色尖形散落在暗色立方体之间。调色严格限定在黑、银白、旧金和鲜明猩红。几乎所有亮面都覆着点、排线或微小重复花纹，使图像有印刷版刻般表面而非平滑数字明暗。亮高光打在凸起边缘与金色点缀上，黑底依旧深而不透明。构图乍看对称，但零星不对称符号使它保持不安。整幅图像像一座谜样的徽章世界，由中央凝视和密集的花纹碎片边框精心搭成。
style_prompt_en: Intricate surreal graphic engraving packs a square field with stippled shading, short hatch curves, tessellated borders, and compact geometric fragments. Black carries most of the area; silver-white shapes, antique-gold accents, and sharp crimson stripes establish a strict hierarchy. A large horizontally stretched central form can be ringed by smaller stepped structures and emblematic motifs, giving the image near-symmetry without perfect duplication. Curved organic edges meet rectilinear grids and columns. Highlights catch ridges and small metallic details, while the background remains opaque and deep. The visual density is deliberate: patterned microdetail rewards close viewing, and broad dark intervals preserve enough contrast for the central focal shape to read immediately.
style_prompt_zh: 精细超现实图形版刻用点描明暗、短弯排线、镶嵌边框和紧凑几何碎片塞满方形画域。黑色占最大面积；银白形体、旧金点缀和锐利猩红条带建立严格层级。一个横向延展的大型中央形体可由较小阶梯结构和徽章式图案围住，形成近似对称而非完美复制。有机曲边与直角网格、立柱相遇。高光捉住脊线与小块金属细节，背景仍深暗不透明。视觉密度有意安排：微小纹样值得近看，宽阔黑暗间隔又保留足够对比，让中央焦点形体一眼可读。
theme_en: An enormous watchful eye above a surreal stepped city of symbols
theme_zh: 巨大的凝视之眼悬于符号组成的超现实阶梯城市上方
name: Patrick Seymour
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
